results.title: Brand-check tests: replace git-history comparisons with current-tree assertions

failures.test: tools/brand-check/a2d-desktop-providers-removed.test.ts > A2d module tree (compiler stand-in) > no source still calls or imports maybe_notify_frontend_of_grok_errors
failures.error: Failed at 5112 ms, just past vitest's default 5000 ms test timeout. Only seen in the first full-suite run.
failures.cause: Flaky timing, not a code or F1 test bug. Under full-suite parallel load, a git grep across the repo ran past the 5 s default timeout. It passed when a2d ran alone (194/194) and on a second full-suite run (831/831). The new f1 file adds about 4.7 s of live greps in parallel, which probably raises the load. Suggested fix, for a developer only: raise testTimeout in tools/brand-check/vitest.config.ts or pass a per-test timeout in a2d. This is not in the HANDOFF baseline, but it does not reproduce.

report.summary:
F1 passes, with one flaky timeout in an existing test.

- **Targeted run:** f1-current-tree-only.test.ts passed 149/149 (6.6 s).
- **Full brand-check suite:** the first run had 1 failure out of 831 tests (10 of 11 files passed). The failure was a timeout at 5112 ms in a2d-desktop-providers-removed, in the "maybe_notify_frontend_of_grok_errors" test. a2d passed 194/194 when run alone, and a second full-suite run passed 831/831 across all 11 files.
- **Assessment:** this looks like a flaky timing problem: under parallel load the git grep runs just past vitest's 5 s default, and the new F1 file's live greps add to that load. It is not in the HANDOFF baseline, but it does not reproduce. It is not a code bug.
- **Suggestion:** a developer could raise testTimeout in E:/research-clones/h0x-video-studio/app/frontend/tools/brand-check/vitest.config.ts.
- **Git status:** the only new file is the untracked E:/research-clones/h0x-video-studio/app/frontend/tools/brand-check/f1-current-tree-only.test.ts. The 10 existing suite files show as modified from earlier layers. That is expected, and I changed nothing.
- **Not run:** no cargo or nx build, because of the RAM rule.

report.summary:
F2 is green.
- The targeted file `E:/research-clones/h0x-video-studio/app/frontend/libs/components/model-selector/src/lib/provider-selector.test.tsx` passes 21/21.
- The full model-selector suite passes: 4 files, 64/64 tests (run with `npx vitest run` inside the lib folder).
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p libs/components/model-selector/tsconfig.lib.json` (run from `frontend/`) gives 0 errors, exit 0. `tsconfig.lib.json` excludes test files, so the typecheck does not cover the new test file.

There are no failures, and none are new compared with the HANDOFF baseline. The model-selector lib is not listed in the HANDOFF baseline failures.

Not run:
- cargo, because the RAM rule allows it only in A2.
- nx build.
- vitest from `frontend/` root. The test-writer reports that it fails with "All projects should have unique names", a workspace config problem outside F2.
